title: MiloScribe
description: A mobile-first web app that records doctor–patient consultations and generates structured medical documents using Google Gemini. Shaped by direct feedback from a practicing surgeon. Drawing on my background as a medical laboratory technologist, I designed the data model, the clinical document structures, and the AI safety boundaries that separate legitimate documentation from fabricated clinical content.

title: WMS Outgoing Orders Dashboard
description: A real-time warehouse management dashboard for tracking and managing outgoing orders. Features live updates across connected clients via Socket.io, full CRUD, and a status timeline showing each order's progression from picking to dispatch.

title: Letterboxd
description: A full-stack film reviewing app powered by TMDB and OMDB APIs. Users can review and rate films, build watchlists, like movies, and keep a personal diary of watched films. Features JWT authentication and a MongoDB backend.
